title: Brex journal carousel
description: A centred 48px headline over a horizontal carousel of article cards that bleeds off the right edge: a small-radius image, a 24px title and a short description per card. Two round grey arrow buttons below scroll one card at a time; the previous arrow fades at the start.
notes: media slots: one 316×178 image per article
cards are 316px wide (246px on phones) with an 80px gap (24px on phones)
scrolling is native with scroll-snap; the arrows call scrollBy
